boss:3.text: He was the founder and owner of the F.E.A.S.T. shelter. At the same time, he was also secretly the ruthless leader of a criminal group known as the Inner Demons and possesses the ability to harness a form of negative energy at will. He had a personal vendetta against Mayor Norman Osborn, which led him to terrorize the city.

boss:4.text: Born around 1979,[a] in Endicott, New York, Max Dillon was involved in an unspecified accident which granted him the ability to absorb electricity and deploy it in destructive blasts. Becoming the super-criminal Electro, Dillon had several encounters with Peter Parker's Spider-Man over the years. At one point, he perpetrated a killing spree for which Spider-Man was blamed by J.

boss:5.text: After spending years incarcerated in the Raft, the armored brute is released by Doctor Octopus, who makes him part of his supervillain group the Sinister Six. After being locked up and sent to the Raft, he escaped again during a prison transfer, becoming an enforcer for Roxxon. Aleksei Sytsevich was born around 1977[a] in Irkutsk, Russia.

boss:6.text: A brilliant scientist with an expertise in prosthetics, Octavius built a neural interface capable of controlling robotic arms. He co-founded the megacorporation Oscorp alongside Norman Osborn, before parting ways due to disagreements over GR-27 (Devil's Breath).
